patterns.note: Strict horizontal grid lines separate sections, creating a clean, directory-like editorial structure with no vertical borders.
High-contrast typographic hierarchy pairing bold, tightly-tracked sans-serif headers with tiny, structured metadata labels.
A strictly monochromatic palette utilizing a soft, warm off-white background and stark black elements to mimic printed editorial design.
Subtle scroll-triggered fade-ins and slide-ups (using AOS) that reveal structured list items sequentially as the user scrolls.

technique_notes: Recreate the layout using a CSS grid with explicit border-bottoms on rows to build a clean, table-like directory structure. For the massive footer graphic, use an absolute-positioned, overflow-hidden container with viewport-width-based font sizing to scale the brand name across the entire screen width.
Implement AOS (Animate On Scroll) to trigger subtle, staggered fade-ups on the list items and services table as they enter the viewport, maintaining a premium, understated feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized bold headings and a massive screen-filling footer graphic contrasted against tiny, structured metadata labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp for layout blocks and dividers, with subtle rounding on the floating navigation pill
design_tokens.spacing: airy and spacious vertical padding balanced by dense, compact metadata lists

standout: The colossal, screen-spanning 'flex' wordmark at the footer that transforms brand typography into a massive graphic anchor, paired with a live-updating local timezone clock.
